 Fabrizio Romano Reveals Benjamin Sesko Decision On Leaving Man Utd For Juventus 
 Fabrizio Romano reveals Benjamin Sesko decision on leaving Man Utd for Juventus
 James Holland 
 20 Nov 2026 11:14 AM 
 Benjamin Sesko with Juventus and Man Utd badges 
 Benjamin Sesko will be staying at Manchester United in January despite being linked with a move to Juventus, according to Fabrizio Romano.
 Sesko has had a frustrating campaign so far, as he has been limited to just two goals and six appearances for Man Utd due to his shin injury coming back. The issue affected Sesko towards the end of last season and returned against Brighton in the League Cup on September 16.
 United hope the striker will return before the end of January, which would give new boss Mauricio Pochettino a major boost.
 Despite Sesko currently being out of action, recent reports in the Italian media have claimed Juventus have reignited their interest in him.
 But Romano has shut down the idea of the 23-year-old leaving Old Trafford this winter.
 “Some Italian outlets have been linking Benjamin Sesko with a move to Juventus in the January transfer window,” the journalist said on YouTube .
 READ: Man Utd circus bottom of Premier League club ranking for manageability 
 “It’s not the first time Benjamin Sesko [has] got links with Italian clubs. AC Milan were following him when he was at [the] Red Bull group, Salzburg [and] Leipzig.
 “And now, links with Juventus, because Juventus might be on the market in January for a new striker, despite signing Randal Kolo Muani and Nick Woltemade from PSG and from Newcastle in the summer transfer window.
 “The link between Benjamin Sesko and Juventus, according to my information, is not true. So, there is nothing between Juventus and Sesko.
 “My understanding is that Sesko’s intention is to stay at Manchester United, to get back as soon as possible.
 ‘Sesko wants to stay at United’ – Fabrizio Romano
 “Sesko has been unlucky. Sesko was not back on the pitch these weeks, and so couldn’t contribute to Manchester United in a difficult moment.
 “But Benjamin Sesko believes in Man Utd, Benjamin Sesko has a great relationship with everyone at Man Utd.
 “Sesko wants to stay at United, and so a January exit is not planned.”
 Juve could have more luck in chasing fellow United striker Joshua Zirkzee, as Romano added there is a serious chance the Dutchman will head back to Serie A in January.
 Romano stated that the Red Devils will try to bring in a new No 9 ‘regardless’ of whether Zirkzee stays or goes.
 However, United are looking for a market opportunity, as they are not prepared to move for a ‘super expensive’ striker mid-season.
